title: COURSE.md frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of an Agent Courses 0.1 COURSE.md file. Unknown keys are allowed; validators warn about them.

spec.description: The specification version the course was written for.

name.description: A kebab id equal to the course folder name.

description.description: What the learner builds and who it is for.

version.description: The course's own Semantic Versioning version.

license.description: An SPDX identifier, or the name of a licence file in the course.

compatibility.description: The tools, accounts and costs the learner needs.

project.description: Where the learner works: one option or a list of options. Omitted means own.

metadata.description: language, author and homepage are strings. Any other key names a runner and holds that runner's settings.

anyOf.description: A Git repository at a tag or commit, with no credentials.
